# Architecture Foundations

- Machine-readable artifacts are canonical; Markdown is generated.
- Definitions, Artifact Types, instances, evidence, approval, admission, activation, and execution remain separate.
- Bounded contexts recurse using the same internal planes without repeating the context name.
- Imported v2 bytes remain source evidence below plane-local import boundaries.
- Runtime and dependency state is reconstructed from profiles and locks.

## Candidate status

This architecture is a product candidate and has no authority effect.
